# Test Fixtures

Fixtures are sanitized, deterministic, and must not contain credentials,
private repository content, or live mutation targets. A fixture documents its
identity dimensions and the public/runtime surface that consumes it.

The RFC-BPR-0001 foundation fixture records shared/private authority
disagreement and the expected deterministic event sequence. Later RFCs extend
this root with GitHub/GHES contracts, Git histories, diffs, conversations,
ledger state, and agent protocols.
